A saved URL is a page you can return to with Reset. You can still browse normally. Applies to tabs outside folders.

Use my Even Better New Tab Button appearance
Reuse its saved plus-animation and button-roundness choices. No extra mod is needed for the second button; it stays visible outside the scrolling lists.

Click the Space banner to collapse the upper zone
Turning this off also expands a currently collapsed upper zone.

Show an Unload button on folder rows
Unloading releases pages from memory, keeping their tabs, current pages and folder layout. Unload remains available in the right-click menu.
